Strengthened production reliability with audit-grade observability for regulated AI workflows, pairing evaluation gates with telemetry and rollback controls.

Built high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms across AWS and Databricks Lakehouse data flows, vector services, and parallel decision workflows.
